ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $19B in fraud in Minnesota and follow the money to see where it leads
questions: Where did the $19B in alleged fraud come from?
Who is involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial wrongdoing and shed light on the alleged fraud in Minnesota. By following the money, we may be able to identify key players and uncover a larger scheme.
